name: Dimension Hopper
description: Portal guns. Press nine ender pearls into a reinforced pearl, brew it into a concentrated teleportation potion (do not drink it) and that into unstable portal fluid; build a chamber around the fluid, a handle, a nether star at the tip: a Portal Gun, which opens a swirling green portal to a random dimension. Bolt a dimensional computer onto it for the Dimension Hopper, which dials any dimension - and coordinates in it - or a realm another game opens to this world.
